clips.title: The story
paras: A courier carries Podrig's weapons request from the Sepulcher to the Undercity. A dread bat bears the message over Silverpine Forest to the Forsaken capital.

Karos Razok handles the dread bats at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. They carry messengers and supplies between the Forsaken capital and its frontline outposts. The roads below are dangerous, with hostile beasts, Moonrage worgen, and Scourge remnants. The bats give urgent military requests a swift route to the capital.

In the Undercity's Trade Quarter, the courier brings Podrig's equipment request to Gordon Wendham. The weaponsmith prepares arms for the Dark Lady's cause and keeps outposts such as the Sepulcher supplied with battle-ready weapons. Those outposts defend the young Forsaken nation against its surrounding enemies.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: One of my bats can take you to the Undercity, for a small fee. Speak with me again when you are ready so that we may arrange your transport.
You will find Gordon Wendham in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity. That is the same quarter where my bat will land.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I keep my weapons in top condition. They are cleaned and ready for use.

clips.title: Completion
paras: An order from the Sepulcher? Very well. It is an honor to serve those who serve our Dark Lady.
